title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（藤田萩乃研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Fujita Hagino)
teachers:
FUJITA Hagino
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will
(1) acquire basic knowledge of electromagnetism and thermodynamics.
(2) acquire engineering application skills and research promotion skills.
advice:
The target fields are as follows.

1. Methods and equipment design for efficiently heating materials that can be heated by microwaves
2. Development of cooling systems using thermoacoustic engines that use solar heat as input
3. Development of safe and easy-to-use far-infrared cooking appliances

We will develop microwave heating devices and plasma generators that contribute to industrial applications by improving heating efficiency. We will also develop thermoacoustic engine refrigeration devices that contribute to the development of local agriculture by cooling the surface of farmland and the water used in hydroponics in summer. Furthermore, we will present an engineering approach to making cooking more delicious in the process of developing a general-purpose far-infrared cooker.

1. Methods and equipment design for efficiently heating materials that can be heated by microwaves

3. Development of safe and easy-to-use far-infrared cooking appliances

We will develop microwave heating devices and plasma generators that contribute to industrial applications by improving heating efficiency. We will also develop thermoacoustic engine refrigeration devices that contribute to the development of local agriculture by cooling the surface of farmland and the water used in hydroponics in summer.
